Behind every interaction with CSG is a real person who cares about your success. With thousands of CSGers in 25 countries, we operate everywhere your customers do. We speak the language of your market. We understand the problems you’re trying to solve.
Guided by principles, driven for success

In an industry full of over-promising, we prefer over-delivering. Digital transformation requires more than just a shiny new platform. It takes people who actually understand your systems, your industry, and your future goals.
We empower everyone to be their true authentic selves so they can do their best work. We foster belonging by treating all with respect. We provide equal access to growth opportunities.
Pushing boundaries pushes us forward. We encourage our people to take calculated risks so they can learn what does or doesn’t work—and discover innovations that spark change.

We put our customers at the center of everything we do, whether it’s finding the perfect solution or taking care of operations. We’re working for you, so you can focus on driving your business forward.

pages.raw_meta: Make it easy for customers to pay on their terms. CSG's flexible payment solutions support every channel, method, and business model at scale.
raw_blocks: NEC and Netcracker Complete Acquisition of CSG Systems. The integration of CSG with Netcracker creates a more comprehensive and unified digital platform. Learn More
Simplify your payments and accelerate your revenue
Stop juggling multiple processors. Connect your entire payment ecosystem online, in-person, and by phone into a single, scalable cloud platform designed to fuel your growth.
One platform for every payment channel
Seamlessly process credit, debit, ACH, and digital wallets from anywhere. Eliminate operational complexity and get your funds faster.
Accept payments wherever your customers are
Offer a frictionless checkout experience across every touchpoint. Easily integrate flexible payment methods to boost conversions and loyalty.
Drive conversions with seamless online checkout
Securely accept online payments on any device with easy integration options for a fast, frictionless checkout experience.
Integrate easily: Seamlessly connect payments to your existing website to capture revenue instantly.
Accept digital wallets: Boost conversions by offering Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, and Venmo.
Accelerate checkout: Reduce cart abandonment with intuitive, mobile-optimized payment flows.
Ensure security: Protect sensitive data with native tokenization and PCI-compliant processing.
Speed up the line with modern POS solutions
Equip your physical locations with secure, chip-enabled point-of-sale (POS) terminals that process transactions in seconds.
Process everywhere: Deploy EMV, swipe, tap, and mobile wallet capabilities securely.
Go mobile: Turn your mobile device into a lean, powerful payment processing machine.
Unify the data: Connect in-person transaction data seamlessly with your online channels.
Enhance the experience: Reduce wait times and deliver frictionless checkout for every customer.
Automate secure payments over the phone
Never miss a payment. Empower your customers to securely pay their bills 24/7 through an automated Interactive Voice Response (IVR) system.
Customize the flow: Tailor your IVR scripts to match your exact business requirements.
Ensure compliance: Keep sensitive card and eCheck data completely out of your call center.
Reduce overhead: Automate routine payment collections and free up your support staff.
Stay accessible: Provide a reliable, around-the-clock payment channel for your customers.
Lower your costs with expert ACH processing
Leverage our direct connections to 20+ banks and status as a Nacha-preferred partner to process fast, reliable payments.
Access funds faster: Turn customer payments into usable working capital with Same-Day ACH.
Reduce your fees: Significantly lower your processing costs compared to traditional card networks.
Ensure compliance: Maintain strict Nacha compliance with built-in, automated account validation.
Simplify returns: Manage complex ACH returns effortlessly with our automated lifecycle tools.
Total control over your payment lifecycle
Go beyond simple processing. Equip your operations team with the tools needed to present bills, manage returns, and automate updates.

Improve cash flow predictability and enhance the customer experience. Easily schedule recurring billing cycles while our Account Updater tool automatically refreshes expired card details to prevent failed transactions and churn.

Transform your billing experience. Let your customers easily search their invoices and pay instantly through secure, branded portals. Reduce your collection costs and get paid faster without relying on paper statements.
See why businesses rely on CSG Forte Payments to power their full potential.
Manage cash flow efficiently at scale—and add protection layers that reinforce your clients' peace of mind.
Process billing and payment interactions with fast, secure payments that cut churn, alleviate risk, and reduce costs.

Streamline collections with HIPAA-compliant payment options. Whether you’re taking patient payments or closing insurance claims, we remove the manual work so your providers and facilities get paid faster.
Unify your in-store and online sales into a single view. Accept any payment method, increase transaction completion, and reduce friction across every channel.
Simplify the monthly bill. Recurring ACH and card options help you reduce delinquencies, lower the cost of acceptance, and give customers the self-service flexibility they expect.

From taxes to permits to parking tickets, accept payments securely from all government agencies and departments. We handle the complex service fee logic and strict compliance standards so you can focus on serving the public.
Ditch the paper checks. Let tenants pay via text, app, or web. We automate the flow of funds from tenant to landlord, ensuring rent is paid on time and books are closed faster.

CSG Forte awarded Recurring Payment Innovation at the 2024 Juniper Future Digital Awards
Ready to level up your payments?
Stop juggling multiple systems. Talk to our experts today to see how our unified cloud platform can accelerate your revenue and reduce operational costs.

The best global payment solutions for SaaS companies combine gateway flexibility, multi-currency support, recurring billing, and embedded payment capabilities in a single platform. The right solution depends on business model, geography, and whether the company needs to monetize through direct billing, resellers, or embedded payments within their own product.

The right payment solution depends on your business model, transaction volume, channels, and customer expectations. Key factors include whether you need gateway-only or full acquiring, support for ACH and card, recurring billing, fraud prevention, and how payments will be embedded or presented to end customers.

Payments are a critical moment in the customer journey. Flexible payment options, frictionless checkout, real-time confirmation, and proactive communication around payment status all reduce friction, improve satisfaction, and increase on-time payment rates across channels.

No. CSG Forte Payments is designed to integrate with existing checkout, portal, and POS environments via APIs and hosted payment fields. Businesses can add payment capabilities without rebuilding their current customer-facing experience, reducing implementation risk and time to go-live.

Yes. CSG Forte Payments supports tokenization and encryption for both card and ACH bank payments, reducing PCI scope and protecting sensitive payment data. Hosted fields and tokenization ensure that raw card data never touches client systems, simplifying compliance and reducing breach risk.
